title: Occurrence
description: Durable, queryable package-level state for Occurrence packages. Fixed fields are related_packages and status. Optional top-level keys matching ^issues/[^/]+$ may route an issue folder to the persistent participant who owes the next package-level action. Routing is convenience/discovery state, not required for issue correctness and never represents an ephemeral execution. Legacy flat issue-route keys ending in .md remain schema-valid during package migration because they also match this bounded namespace.

related_packages.description: Durable upstream package dependencies as package-name to relationship-name mappings.

status.description: Package lifecycle status, not revision, issue, or claim status.

^issues/[^/]+$.description: Optional routing participant for an issue. In the current folder model the key is the issue-folder logical path and the value names the persistent participant responsible for advancing the package-level loop. The route is not required for issue validity and must not model an ephemeral recruit.
